name: Shape Deformation for Bandsaw Cutting
definition: A method to deform a triangle mesh to make it more 'cutable' by orthogonal cuts while preserving its overall shape. It uses rasterized filled silhouettes generated via the mellowmax operator.
summary: Shape Deformation for Bandsaw Cutting deforms triangle meshes to enable orthogonal cuts by minimizing cut energy and ARAP regularization, reducing volume differences between desired and actual results.
